description: This file defines a Roslyn analyzer for C# that detects method parameters with ref modifiers in interface implementations of IAddressable, and reports diagnostics if such parameters are found.

classes.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer that checks for ref parameters in interface method implementations of IAddressable and reports errors if found.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the analysis context, configuring analysis of generated code, enabling concurrent execution, and registering syntax node actions for method declarations.

methods.name: AnalyzeSyntax
methods.description: Analyzes method declaration syntax nodes to identify ref parameters in interface implementations of IAddressable and reports diagnostics.
